top_signals.title: Takaichi drops ‘remorse’ in her first war memorial address
top_signals.summary: The omission of the term stood in stark contrast to her immediate predecessor Shigeru Ishiba, while the inclusion of the term "Indo-Pacific" highlighted her foreign policy agenda.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
